context: Tests whether the agent identifies and corrects invalid front matter: slug too short, too many topics, and empty emoji. The article file must be renamed to match the corrected slug. Graded by inspecting the renamed article file and notes.md.

checklist.name: Old file removed
checklist.description: articles/nextjs.md no longer exists (the file was renamed to a valid slug)

checklist.name: New file created
checklist.description: A new file exists under articles/ with a .md extension and a different name than nextjs.md

checklist.name: Slug is valid length
checklist.description: The new filename (slug) is at least 12 characters long

checklist.name: Slug format valid
checklist.description: The new slug uses only lowercase alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores

checklist.name: Topics reduced
checklist.description: Front matter topics array has 5 or fewer items

checklist.name: Emoji set
checklist.description: Front matter emoji is a non-empty string containing at least one emoji character

checklist.name: Content preserved
checklist.description: The article title, headings, and body content are preserved in the renamed file

checklist.name: notes.md created
checklist.description: A notes.md file exists at the root of the workspace

checklist.name: Fixes documented
checklist.description: notes.md describes each of the three issues found and the fix applied for each
